why: Full classification remains explicitly open, but 2025 papers settle cases of it for specific graph families: split/split-comparability graphs (Feb 2025, arXiv:2502.00872, proving a uniform bound of 3 and finding exact obstructions) and co-bipartite graphs (Sept 2025, arXiv:2509.03064/2509.03064, showing all non-permutation word-representable co-bipartite graphs have representation number exactly 3).
